name: Swizzling
aliases: Swizzled Texture Addressing with Bitwise Carry Propagation
definition: A memory layout technique where the linear memory address bits are rearranged (swizzled) to improve spatial locality. It effectively forms the linear address then swaps some of the memory address bits around.
summary: Swizzling rearranges memory address bits to improve spatial locality and cache performance, differing from simple tiling by using bit interleaving rather than chopping images into subrects.
